name: Brookfield Corp
thesis: Three reinforcing compounders inside one wrapper — (1) BAM fee-related earnings (capital-light, scaling with fundraising), (2) BNRE insurance float earning >9% on assets across the cycle, (3) realizations cadence monetizing a $200B+ deployed-capital book on a multi-year cycle. The bet: DE/share grows 15%+ over a cycle, with the share buyback closing the persistent NAV discount.
key_driver: DE/share growth driven by FRE + BNRE float earnings + realizations cadence

tier_1_kpis.name: Fundraising pace (flagship vintages, private credit, insurance)
Realizations / monetizations ($ and count)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: 2 Qs of <$1B carried interest realized without pipeline explanation

tier_3_kpis.name: Plan value vs intrinsic value disclosure

nuance.bear_case: Insurance reserve/credit-loss surprise at BNRE could blindside the model — float math depends on consistent earnings yield, and a single bad year of credit losses can compound. CRE writedown cycle deeper than provisioned is a separate but related tail risk.
nuance.adversarial_take: Three compounders only work if all three keep working — a flagship fundraising stall (>2 years), CRE shock, OR BNRE credit miss can each independently break the math. Diversification is the bull case but also creates more failure modes.
nuance.stress_test: BNRE earnings yield <9% + flagship undersubscribed in any single cycle would force a re-evaluation; 2 Qs of <$1B carried-interest realizations without pipeline color is the early canary.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Insurance reserve/credit loss surprise at BNRE
CRE writedown cycle deeper than provisioned
BNRE earnings yield on float <9% for 2 consecutive Qs
